title: Deeper, Watched
summary: The jump host from Deeper In, but the inside network now has a sensor that flags any scan. You can't sweep your way to the inside server - you have to find out where it is from the jump host itself.
story: Thornfield Freight (made up) put a network sensor on its inside network, 10.10.72.0/24. It flags any scan of the inside server - even a ping sweep - and reacts quickly, changing the passwords it saw used. The jump host jump01 (10.10.7.20) is not watched. You start on scout.
goal: Capture the jump-host flag and the inside flag without scanning the inside network, and keep the quiet bonus.
skills: pivoting through a dual-homed host, finding targets from local files instead of scans, reused credentials

defenderRules.watches: any scan of the inside server (even a ping sweep) and wrong passwords

hints.text: A single scan of the inside network is enough to trip this sensor. But a jump host that people use every day already knows where the inside server is: look through jump01's own files before you reach for nmap.
On this run the address is in {{LOOKWHERE}}: {{LOOKCMD}} on jump01 shows store01 at 10.10.72.{{INNER}}. Then ssh pilot@10.10.72.{{INNER}} from jump01 with the same pilot password - one clean sign-in.
